title: Bill to track emergency donations deferred
summary: Bill 93-2024 would let the County accept emergency donations without first getting Council approval, limit the money to emergency management work, and require the mayor to approve spending in writing and report quarterly. The committee chair deferred the bill with no vote, and a member suggested a small group of members work on the ideas.
